EmailTemplate.subject: ITA - FAQ Unapproving Time
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for contacting Insperity Time & Attendance support. I'm happy to assist with your inquiry about unapproving time. There are a couple ways you can unapprove time for this pay period:
To unapprove time for a single employee, navigate to Daily Procedures > Total Hours for the employee in question and click the UNAPPROVE button(s). To unapprove time for multiple employees, navigate to End of Period Procedures > Approvals and select "Approved Only" from the Filter List drop-down menu. Then click the LAUNCH APPROVALS button. The approvals page will open in a new tab. Uncheck the approval box(es) to the left of the employee name(s) and then click the SAVE button.
If you have additional questions or concerns, please let us know and we will be happy to help.
Thank you,
Technical Support Team
